name: violet-builtin-v1
notes: Built-in bootstrap corpus. ASR items carry no audio file, so audio is synthesised deterministically and WER is NOT measurable against them.
Production validators must point VALIDATOR_EVALSET_PATH at a private corpus with real audio, rotated on a schedule (TDD 9.3).
Add an 'audio_path' to each ASR item, relative to this manifest, to enable real WER scoring.
TTS items are fully usable as shipped: content fidelity is measured from the returned audio against the prompt text.
